Game Overview

In Blue And Red Man, the core idea is straightforward: guide your vibrant stickman army through dynamic 3D obstacle courses, cleverly navigating math gates to grow your forces. Avoid traps, strategically tackle challenges, and outwit enemy crowds to reach the finish line intact. Quick reflexes and smart choices will lead to triumph in this captivating time-killer game.
